lines: One day after the zombie incident was resolved.
Around the "Gate to Another World," which connects this world to another,
Taimanin units that had arrived from outside the city, along with government security forces, had begun the cleanup and investigation of the incident.
And among those conducting the investigation were Saya and I.
Me
How is it going, Saya? Have you noticed anything after taking a look around?
Takagi Saya
Hmm, not really so far. I mean, I'm an amateur, so it's only natural I wouldn't know much.
Saya
But it does seem true that 'they' have vanished from the city, just like you said.
Me
Yes. The investigation teams at various locations in the city have reported the same thing.
Me
It seems those demons and the zombies were more deeply connected than we had imagined.
Saya
I wonder how that happened. Honestly, there's so much we don't know about 'them'.
Saya
Well, complaining won't solve anything. Fuuma, show me that data. I also want to hear from the people on the investigation team.
Me
Understood. I'll arrange it right away.
While exchanging such remarks, Saya and I were present for the investigation of the Gate.
She—Takagi Saya—is a girl who came from a world different from ours.
Saya's world is on the brink of destruction due to the mass outbreak of the walking dead.
In that situation, she was suddenly summoned to this world, along with a horde of the dead and two companions.
They were at a loss over the sudden turn of events, but
without giving up, they continued to survive in this world until they encountered our Taimanin unit.
For the purpose of "returning to their original world," they began to cooperate with us.
After overcoming several troubles, they reached the "Gate to Another World," the root cause of the incident,
and defeated the demon of the Brain Flea, the invading species that guarded it.
With this, there was no longer any obstacle preventing Saya and the others from returning to their original world...
Yet as you can see, Saya is still in this world, participating in the cleanup and investigation.
The reason for this is...
One day earlier.
Saya
Haa...? No way, 'they' have completely vanished?
Saya and the others stared in disbelief.
It was right after we defeated the demon of the Brain Flea that had been guarding the "Gate."
As the three of them were about to return to their original world, I called out, "Wait a moment!"
Me
I just got a message from Professor Asagi at headquarters... our superior.
Me
The corpses that were flooding the streets have disappeared. This has been confirmed by surveillance satellite footage and reports from the reconnaissance unit.
Me
It is likely that the demon we just defeated, or the Brain Flea ruins we blew up...
Me
...contained something that was supporting the actions of the dead.
Saya
I see... indeed, the moment the underground ruins were blown up, 'their' movements slowed down.
Saya nodded, recalling the events of the battle.
Me
Yes. So, Professor Asagi has a request for the three of you.
With the zombies gone, there was no longer a need to rush the destruction of the "Gate to Another World."
Therefore, they asked Saya and the others to delay their return by a few days so they could hear them out.
Rei
Talk to us? What do you want to know?
Me
Mainly about 'them' and your world.
Me
This time it was contained to this city, but if the zombies were to erupt on a large scale, our world could face collapse.
Me
They want information to formulate preventive measures and countermeasures.
Saeko
Hmm. I understand your situation, and we are indebted to you for your help. We would be more than willing to cooperate, but...
Saya
Exactly. We are not idle either. We left our comrades behind, and if we can, we want to go home as soon as possible.
Me
I understand how you feel. So, it will basically just be a conversation, and I think it will be over in one or two days.
Me
Besides, we have prepared a reward. We also want to properly thank you for your cooperation...
Me
For example, a delicious meal or a warm bath...
Three People
The three of them's eyes glinted at my words.
Due to these circumstances, Takagi Saya and the others decided to postpone their return for a few days,
and I, who had fought alongside them this time, was assigned to serve as their host and escort during that period.
Time passed, and night fell.
The power supply was being restored, but it was not yet sufficient for nighttime investigations.
So the soldiers around the "Gate" also wrapped up their investigations for the day and headed back to their barracks.
Saya
Hmm, that's the limit for today. Let's pull out, Fuuma-kun.
Me
Understood, Takagi Saya. However... we didn't learn almost anything today.
Saya
I know. I thought we might get at least some information, but it wasn't that easy.
Takagi Saya said that and shrugged her shoulders.
The reason Takagi Saya had been present for the "Gate" investigation that day was because she herself had requested it.
Saya
Since we're staying longer anyway, I want to investigate 'them' a little while I'm in this world.
That was Takagi Saya's request.
She wanted to find out the cause of the zombies in this world disappearing,
hoping it might provide a clue to fighting the zombies in their own world.
However...
Saya
In the end, no significant results. It's only to be expected after just one day.
The investigation team's activities today ended with merely collecting basic data on the "Gate."
At this rate, they likely won't uncover any new facts before they leave.
Me
That's a shame... I was hoping I could be of some help to you and the others.
Saya
Aha! Hey, Fuuma-kun, why are you making that depressed face! Don't worry about it.
Saya
I don't expect to figure out 'their' secrets or how to defeat them that easily either.
Saya
I just want to do what I can if there's even a slight possibility. That's all it is.
And with that, Saya-san looked at me with a mischievous smile.
Saya
Well, setting that aside, it's about time we head out, Fuuma-kun.
Saya
My 'other request'... you've got it all arranged, right?
Me
Yes, of course...
Saya-san had given me, her host, two requests.
One was to witness the investigation of the "Gate" being conducted during the day.
And the other was...
Saya
Oh! The atmosphere is great! It's a proper open-air bath, just like I requested!
Saya
Fuuma-kun, you really are quite the capable one, aren't you?
Me
Ah, thank you...
I nodded, slightly stammering.
This was a hot spring inn on the outskirts of town.
Saya-san's "other request" was
to soak leisurely in a hot spring bath, something impossible to enjoy in this world of collapsed civilization.
To fulfill her wish, I had struggled to find a hot spring inn with minimal zombie damage
and managed to arrange for the restoration so the baths could be used.
Me
(Yes, everything was fine up to that point, but...)
Me
...Um, Saya-san, I'm glad you're happy, but... are you really expecting me to bathe with you?
I asked, feeling increasingly uneasy.
Yes, the hot spring here was co-ed.
Both Saya-san and I would be in swimsuits, soaking in the bath together.
Saya
What? You don't want to be with me?
Me
N-no, I'd be happy to, but... I assumed I'd be waiting outside.
However, Saya-san sat down on a bath chair with a look that said, "Haa. You really don't understand anything."
Saya
Hah? What are you talking about? This inn seems to have been restored in a rush, but the surroundings are still a ruined city.
Saya
Even if 'those things' are gone, dangerous criminals are still wandering around. What if they attack?
Me
Well, that's true...
This city had been flooded with a large number of denizens of the underworld and anarchists.
Even though the Taimanin unit has begun their purge, it is certainly still dangerous.
Saya
Right? If that's the case, there's no choice but to share a bath with you. I mean, as your bodyguard. Just a bodyguard.
Saya
Of course, I'm not embarrassed either. Oh, sharing a bath with a boy...
Saya
No, that's beside the point! You just need to quietly do as you're told!
Saya
You're happy to be in the bath with me, aren't you?
Me
Y-yes! It is an honor...!
I hurriedly nodded several times.
There's no way I wouldn't be happy to share a hot spring with a beautiful girl like Takagi Saya.
Saya
That's right, I'm glad you understand! So, escort boy, shall we start by washing my back?
Saya
Ah, of course, I won't forgive you if you touch any weird spots!
